_note: English content for the hourly quests (SPEC-hourly). Merged into the seed by scripts/gen_team_map_hourly_seed.py (field i18n.en). Edit English text in the CMS afterwards.

read.name: Read and answer
read.title_template: Read about {target}, then answer one question
read.offer_text: Reading time, kiddo. Go read the article about {target}, then let them quiz you to see if it stuck.
read.win_text: You actually read it? I thought you'd just skim it.
read.lose_text: Wrong. Read it again, it's not that long.

fight.name: Fight
fight.offer_text: I hear you want to fight a coworker. Fine, this hour you get to fight {target}. Tap as fast as you can, the bigger the boss the tougher they are.
fight.win_text: You won. Come to work tomorrow like nothing happened, and don't make eye contact.
fight.lose_text: You lost. People on a bigger salary are stronger, nothing strange about that.

poptask.name: Throw pop-tasks
poptask.offer_text: Normally people throw urgent tasks in your face. This hour we switch roles: hit {target} with 3 pop-tasks for me.
poptask.win_text: Fun dumping work on other people, huh? Now you know how the boss feels.
poptask.lose_text: Out of tasks to throw. The company rarely runs out of work like that.

flashcard.name: Flashcards
flashcard.offer_text: {target} loves fancy words. Go flip a few flashcards and see how many you actually understand.
flashcard.win_text: Nice. Now when you nod in meetings, you actually mean it.
flashcard.lose_text: Not enough points. Don't worry, in meetings just keep nodding.

coffee.name: Bring coffee
coffee.offer_text: {target} is falling asleep. Grab a coffee from the Pantry and bring it over, and don't bump into anyone or it spills.
coffee.win_text: Arrived without a drop spilled. Not in the JD, but a precious skill.
coffee.lose_text: Three cups spilled. Let them get their own.

hide.name: Hide and seek
hide.offer_text: {target} skipped the meeting and went into hiding. You have 60 seconds to find them. Ask around to see if anyone spotted them.
hide.win_text: Found them. Back to the meeting, please.
hide.lose_text: Time's up. They hide better than you seek.

race.name: Race
race.offer_text: There are new cakes in the Pantry. Race {target} and see who gets there first. Fair warning: the more junior, the faster they run.
race.win_text: You got there first. The cakes were gone this morning, forgot to tell you.

gossip.name: Gossip
gossip.offer_text: Gossip hour. Go find {partner} and have a little gossip about {target}. Keep it down, if they walk past you shut up right away.
gossip.win_text: All done? I didn't hear a thing, I don't know anything.
gossip.lose_text: You got overheard. Better buy them a bubble tea tomorrow.

lines.hl-001: Could you fix this banner for me, just 5 minutes.
lines.hl-002: This one's urgent, send it to me this afternoon.
lines.hl-003: The client changed their mind, please redo it from scratch.
lines.hl-004: Do this too while you're at it.
lines.hl-005: Demo is tomorrow morning, can you check it tonight?
lines.hl-007: The boss just messaged, do this one first.
lines.hl-008: Just one more screen, no big deal.
lines.hl-012: Put it in the backlog and we'll see.
lines.hl-013: Is this in the sprint? If not, next sprint.
lines.hl-014: Make a ticket and I'll do it.
lines.hl-015: Make a ticket and I'll do it.
lines.hl-016: Let me test whether this task has bugs.
lines.hl-017: That's outside the contract, it'll cost extra.
lines.hl-018: I give people work, nobody gives me work.
lines.hl-019: Sure, I'll do it… but how do I do it?
lines.hl-022: Hold on, I'm holding a coffee.
lines.hl-023: The user is always right. Try me.
lines.hl-024: I'm paying you and you're fighting me?
lines.hl-028: Thanks, just when I was crashing.
lines.hl-031: I think they just slipped past {room}.
lines.hl-032: I didn't say anything, but try {room}.
lines.hl-033: Shh, don't tell anyone I'm here.
lines.hl-034: Just let me hide five more minutes.
lines.hl-035: Wait, let me tie my shoes.
lines.hl-036: What do I win if I get there first?
lines.hl-037: What did you just say about me, Mai?
lines.hl-039: Go on, I'm standing right here listening.
lines.hl-040: An hour-long meeting that ended with scheduling another meeting.
lines.hl-041: Messages get left on seen, then when it's urgent they call three times.
lines.hl-042: Said it was just light feedback, then sent a file with 40 comments.
lines.hl-043: Priorities change every week, and every time it's "the last time".
lines.hl-044: Writes a one-line ticket, then asks why the design isn't what they wanted.
lines.hl-045: When the design is off by 2 pixels it's fine, when we say the build is off it's "hard to do".
lines.hl-046: Whatever you ask, the answer is "the API isn't ready".
lines.hl-047: Says yes to everything, then everything is late.
lines.hl-048: Whenever it's hard, it's "iOS doesn't allow that".
lines.hl-049: Logged a whole bug because a button was half a pixel off.
lines.hl-050: Ask if it can be done: yes. Ask when it'll be done: it depends.
lines.hl-051: After review all they say is "not there yet", without saying where "there" is.
lines.hl-052: Looks at the design for 10 seconds, then asks for three more options.
lines.hl-053: Walks past a screen once and wants the button colour changed.
lines.hl-054: Always asks where the data is, then decides on gut feeling anyway.
lines.hl-055: Wants to rewrite everything from scratch.
lines.hl-056: Skipped every session, shows up on the last day with feedback.
lines.hl-057: Writes a 40-page document and the part we need isn't in it.
lines.hl-058: Asks "is it done?" every day, never asks "do you need help?".
lines.hl-059: Says yes to everything the client wants, then asks the team to "try their best".
lines.hl-060: Says "yes, I get it", then makes something completely different.
lines.hl-061: Asked for a bigger logo, then said it looks too cluttered.
lines.hl-062: Said they loved it, used it once, then deleted it.
lines.hl-063: Ask what to do and the answer is "it depends, we need more interviews".
lines.hl-064: Asked for one number and got told "next week".
lines.hl-065: Makes us do a stand-up every day, and the stand-up takes 45 minutes.
lines.hl-066: Says "be creative, total freedom", then changes it to exactly what he wanted.
lines.hl-067: Promised the client a feature nobody on the team has heard of.

qz-product-manager-1.question: What is a Product Manager mainly responsible for?
options: Deciding which problems the product should solve and what comes first
Writing the code for the main features

qz-product-owner-1.question: In a Scrum team, what does the Product Owner manage?
options: The product backlog and its priorities

qz-product-designer-1.question: Compared with a UI Designer, what extra does a Product Designer usually take on?
options: The whole product problem: from understanding it to measuring results after launch

qz-intern-1.question: What helps a design intern improve fastest?
options: Asking early and asking for feedback often
Hiding work until it is perfect
Doing only what was assigned and never asking more

qz-ds-designer-1.question: What does a Design System Designer create for the whole team?

qz-ux-design-engineer-1.question: A UX Design Engineer sits between which two jobs?

qz-motion-designer-1.question: What does a Motion Designer handle in a product team?
options: Motion and transitions in the interface

qz-frontend-developer-1.question: What does a Frontend Developer turn a design into?
options: A working interface that users interact with directly

qz-backend-developer-1.question: Which part of the product does a Backend Developer handle?
options: Servers, data and the APIs behind the interface

qz-fullstack-developer-1.question: How is a Fullstack Developer different from a Frontend or Backend Developer?
options: They can build both the interface and the server side
They only design and never code

qz-business-analyst-1.question: What does a Business Analyst usually help the team clarify?
options: The business requirements and processes the product must support

qz-stakeholder-1.question: Who is a stakeholder in a project?
options: Someone with an interest in or a say over the outcome, even if they don't do the work

barista-khong-luong.description: Not in the JD, but the skill you use the most.

may-thich-tron-hong.description: Skip a meeting however you like, you will be found.

trum-chay-chot.name: Office sprinter
trum-chay-chot.description: Faster than the intern at 6 pm.
